<USER_REQUEST>
Create a **modern, professional, and visually impressive personal portfolio website** for me using only HTML and CSS in a single file named `index.html`. All HTML and CSS must be included in this one file. Avoid external frameworks and unnecessary dependencies.

### Personal Information
- **Name:** Yash Prabhusing Rajput
- **Education:** First-Year Student at NST-RU
- **Skills:** Basic Python Programming
- **Hobbies:** Watching Cinema, Playing Cricket, Writing, and Public Speaking.

### Design Requirements
1. Create a clean, minimal, premium-looking design with a professional color palette, attractive typography, and excellent spacing.
2. Add a modern hero section with my name, a short introduction, a professional tagline, and clear navigation.
3. Include About Me, Education, Skills, Hobbies, and Contact sections.
4. Use subtle animations and smooth transitions, including fade-in effects, hover interactions, animated buttons, and smooth scrolling.
5. Add elegant cards, icons, and visual elements without making the website look overly fancy or cluttered.
6. Make the website fully responsive for desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
7. Use CSS variables, organized code, semantic HTML, and clean styling.
8. Include a professional footer and social media links with editable placeholders.

### Final Goal
Make my portfolio look like it was designed by a professional web designer. It should be unique, polished, beginner-friendly, easy to navigate, and impressive enough to stand out among my college classmates.

**Output:** Provide the complete, working code in one `index.html` file.
</USER_REQUEST>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Yash Prabhusing Rajput — Portfolio</title>
  <style>
    /* ===== CSS Variables ===== */
    :root {
      --clr-bg:        #0b0d17;
      --clr-surface:   #111425;
      --clr-card:      #161a30;
      --clr-border:    #232842;
      --clr-text:      #e4e6f0;
      --clr-muted:     #8b8fa7;
      --clr-accent:    #6c63ff;
      --clr-accent-lt: #8b83ff;
      --clr-accent-bg: rgba(108,99,255,.08);
      --clr-white:     #ffffff;
      --clr-gradient:  linear-gradient(135deg, #6c63ff 0%, #b24dff 100%);

      --ff-heading: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --ff-body:    'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;

      --fs-hero:  clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
      --fs-h2:    clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.4rem);
      --fs-h3:    1.15rem;
      --fs-body:  1rem;
      --fs-small: 0.875rem;

      --radius:     12px;
      --radius-lg:  20px;
      --shadow:     0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
      --transition: .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }

    /* ===== Reset & Base ===== */
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      scroll-padding-top: 80px;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--ff-body);
      background: var(--clr-bg);
      color: var(--clr-text);
      line-height: 1.7;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    a   { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    ul  { list-style: none; }

    /* ===== Utility ===== */
    .container {
      width: min(1140px, 90%);
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .section {
      padding: 100px 0;
    }

    .section__label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--clr-accent);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section__label::before {
      content: '';
      width: 28px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--clr-accent);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .section__title {
      font-family: var(--ff-heading);
      font-size: var(--fs-h2);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .section__desc {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
    }

    /* ===== Fade-in on scroll ===== */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(36px);
      transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease;
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* ===== Navigation ===== */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      inset-inline: 0;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(11,13,23,.75);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .nav__inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }

    .nav__logo {
      font-family: var(--ff-heading);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      letter-spacing: -.5px;
    }
    .nav__logo span { color: var(--clr-accent); }

    .nav__links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav__links a {
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      position: relative;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__links a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--clr-gradient);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: width var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__links a:hover       { color: var(--clr-white); }
    .nav__links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .nav__toggle {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
    }
    .nav__toggle span {
      display: block;
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--clr-white);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    /* ===== Hero ===== */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding-top: 72px;
    }

    /* Gradient orbs */
    .hero::before,
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(120px);
      opacity: .18;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero::before {
      width: 600px; height: 600px;
      background: var(--clr-accent);
      top: -120px; right: -100px;
    }
    .hero::after {
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: #b24dff;
      bottom: -80px; left: -120px;
    }

    .hero__content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 720px;
    }

    .hero__greeting {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--clr-accent-lt);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      background: var(--clr-accent-bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);
      border-radius: 40px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown .8s ease both;
    }
    .hero__greeting .wave {
      display: inline-block;
      animation: wave 2s ease-in-out infinite;
      transform-origin: 70% 70%;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .hero__name {
      font-family: var(--ff-heading);
      font-size: var(--fs-hero);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown .8s .15s ease both;
    }
    .hero__name .gradient-text {
      background: var(--clr-gradient);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero__tagline {
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-weight: 400;
      animation: fadeSlideDown .8s .3s ease both;
    }

    .hero__bio {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown .8s .45s ease both;
    }

    .hero__actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeSlideDown .8s .6s ease both;
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 30px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }
    .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

    .btn--primary {
      background: var(--clr-gradient);
      color: var(--clr-white);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(108,99,255,.35);
    }
    .btn--primary:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(108,99,255,.5);
    }

    .btn--outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--clr-text);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--clr-border);
    }
    .btn--outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      color: var(--clr-accent-lt);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(108,99,255,.15);
    }

    /* Scroll indicator */
    .hero__scroll {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 36px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      animation: fadeSlideDown 1s 1s ease both;
    }
    .hero__scroll .mouse {
      width: 24px;
      height: 38px;
      border: 2px solid var(--clr-muted);
      border-radius: 14px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero__scroll .mouse::after {
      content: '';
      width: 3px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--clr-accent);
      border-radius: 3px;
      position: absolute;
      top: 6px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      animation: scrollDot 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    /* ===== About ===== */
    .about__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .about__image-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .about__image-box {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/5;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* Avatar placeholder with initials */
    .about__avatar {
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--clr-gradient);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      letter-spacing: 2px;
    }

    .about__image-box::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 50%, var(--clr-card) 100%);
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .about__image-decor {
      position: absolute;
      width: 180px;
      height: 180px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--clr-accent);
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: .2;
      bottom: -40px;
      right: -40px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .about__text p {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
    }

    .about__stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }

    .stat {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 20px 12px;
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }
    .stat:hover {
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .stat__number {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .stat__label {
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      color: var(--clr-muted);
    }

    /* ===== Education ===== */
    #education { background: var(--clr-surface); }

    .timeline {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 700px;
    }

    .timeline::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 20px;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 2px;
      background: var(--clr-border);
    }

    .timeline__item {
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 60px;
      padding-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .timeline__item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }

    .timeline__dot {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      top: 4px;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--clr-bg);
      border: 3px solid var(--clr-accent);
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .timeline__card {
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 28px;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .timeline__card:hover {
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .timeline__year {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--clr-accent);
      background: var(--clr-accent-bg);
      padding: 4px 14px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .timeline__card h3 {
      font-size: var(--fs-h3);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .timeline__card p {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
    }

    /* ===== Skills ===== */
    .skills__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .skill-card {
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .skill-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .skill-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--clr-gradient);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }
    .skill-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

    .skill-card__icon {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: var(--clr-accent-bg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    .skill-card h3 {
      font-size: var(--fs-h3);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .skill-card p {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Skill bar */
    .skill-bar {
      margin-top: 18px;
    }
    .skill-bar__header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .skill-bar__track {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .skill-bar__fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--clr-gradient);
      border-radius: 6px;
      width: 0;
      transition: width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    .skill-bar__fill.animate { width: var(--fill); }

    /* ===== Hobbies ===== */
    #hobbies { background: var(--clr-surface); }

    .hobbies__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .hobby-card {
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .hobby-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .hobby-card__icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--clr-accent-bg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }
    .hobby-card:hover .hobby-card__icon {
      background: rgba(108,99,255,.18);
      transform: scale(1.1);
    }

    .hobby-card h3 {
      font-size: var(--fs-h3);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .hobby-card p {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== Contact ===== */
    .contact__wrapper {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
    }

    .contact__info h3 {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .contact__info p {
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .contact__detail {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .contact__detail-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: var(--clr-accent-bg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .contact__detail-text span {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      color: var(--clr-muted);
    }

    .contact__detail-text a,
    .contact__detail-text strong {
      color: var(--clr-white);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
    }
    .contact__detail-text a:hover {
      color: var(--clr-accent-lt);
    }

    /* Contact form */
    .contact__form {
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px;
    }

    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .form-group label {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--fs-small);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--clr-text);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .form-group input,
    .form-group textarea {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      background: var(--clr-bg);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      color: var(--clr-text);
      font-family: var(--ff-body);
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .form-group input:focus,
    .form-group textarea:focus {
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(108,99,255,.15);
    }

    .form-group textarea {
      resize: vertical;
      min-height: 120px;
    }

    /* ===== Footer ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--clr-surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      padding: 48px 0 28px;
    }

    .footer__inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .footer__brand {
      font-family: var(--ff-heading);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--clr-white);
    }
    .footer__brand span { color: var(--clr-accent); }

    .footer__socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer__socials a {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--clr-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--clr-border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--clr-muted);
      transition: color var(--transition), border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }
    .footer__socials a:hover {
      color: var(--clr-white);
      border-color: var(--clr-accent);
      background: var(--clr-accent-bg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .footer__copy {
      width: 100%;

  <style>
    /* ===== CSS Variables ===== */
    :root {
      --clr-bg:         #050a0e;
      --clr-surface:    #0a1018;
      --clr-card:       #0d1520;
      --clr-card-hover: #111d2b;
      --clr-border:     #1a2a3a;
      --clr-text:       #c8d6e5;
      --clr-muted:      #6b8299;
      --clr-white:      #f0f4f8;

      --clr-accent:     #00e5a0;
      --clr-accent-dim: #00c48c;
      --clr-cyan:       #00c8ff;
      --clr-amber:      #ffb800;

      --clr-accent-bg:  rgba(0,229,160,.07);
      --clr-cyan-bg:    rgba(0,200,255,.07);
      --clr-amber-bg:   rgba(255,184,0,.07);

      --gradient:       linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5a0 0%, #00c8ff 100%);
      --gradient-warm:  linear-gradient(135deg, #ffb800 0%, #ff6b00 100%);
      --gradient-hero:  linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5a0 0%, #00c8ff 50%, #7c5cff 100%);

      --ff: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --ff-mono: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'Consolas', monospace;

      --fs-hero:  clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
      --fs-h2:    clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.4rem);
      --fs-h3:    1.15rem;
      --fs-body:  1rem;
      --fs-small: 0.875rem;
      --fs-xs:    0.75rem;

      --radius:    12px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --shadow:    0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
      --transition:.3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }

    /* ===== Reset ===== */
    *,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px}
    body{font-family:var(--ff);background:var(--clr-bg);color:var(--clr-text);line-height:1.7;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
    img{max-width:100%;display:block}
    a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
    ul{list-style:none}

    /* ===== Utility ===== */
    .container{width:min(1140px,90%);margin-inline:auto}
    .section{padding:100px 0}

    .section__label{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
      font-size:var(--fs-small);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;
      text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--clr-accent);margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    .section__label::before{
      content:'';width:28px;height:2px;
      background:var(--clr-accent);border-radius:2px;
    }

    .section__title{
      font-size:var(--fs-h2);font-weight:700;
      color:var(--clr-white);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.25;
    }

    .section__desc{
      color:var(--clr-muted);max-width:560px;
      margin-bottom:48px;font-size:var(--fs-body);
    }

    /* ===== Reveal on scroll ===== */
    .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(36px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
    .reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

    /* ===== Grid background pattern ===== */
    body::before{
      content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(0,229,160,.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size:60px 60px;
      pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
    }

    /* ===== Navigation ===== */
    .nav{
      position:fixed;inset-inline:0;top:0;z-index:1000;
      background:rgba(5,10,14,.8);
      backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--clr-border);
    }

    .nav__inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:72px}

    .nav__logo{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--clr-white);letter-spacing:-.5px}
    .nav__logo span{
      background:var(--gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
    }

    .nav__links{display:flex;gap:32px}
    .nav__links a{
      font-size:var(--fs-small);font-weight:500;color:var(--clr-muted);
      position:relative;transition:color var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__links a::after{
      content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-4px;left:0;
      width:0;height:2px;background:var(--gradient);
      border-radius:2px;transition:width var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__links a:hover{color:var(--clr-white)}
    .nav__links a:hover::after{width:100%}

    .nav__toggle{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px}
    .nav__toggle span{display:block;width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--clr-white);border-radius:2px;transition:var(--transition)}

    /* ===== Hero ===== */
    .hero{
      min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-top:72px;
    }

    /* Ambient glow orbs */
    .hero__orb{
      position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(120px);
      pointer-events:none;opacity:.12;
    }
    .hero__orb--1{width:600px;height:600px;background:#00e5a0;top:-150px;right:-100px}
    .hero__orb--2{width:500px;height:500px;background:#00c8ff;bottom:-100px;left:-150px}
    .hero__orb--3{width:300px;height:300px;background:#ffb800;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:.06}

    .hero__grid{
      display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;
      align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:1;
    }

    .hero__greeting{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
      font-size:var(--fs-small);font-weight:600;color:var(--clr-accent);
      margin-bottom:20px;padding:6px 16px;
      background:var(--clr-accent-bg);
      border:1px solid rgba(0,229,160,.15);
      border-radius:40px;font-family:var(--ff-mono);
      animation:fadeSlideUp .8s ease both;
    }

    .hero__greeting .blink{animation:blink 1s step-end infinite}

    .hero__name{
      font-size:var(--fs-hero);font-weight:800;
      color:var(--clr-white);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-2px;
      margin-bottom:12px;animation:fadeSlideUp .8s .15s ease both;
    }
    .hero__name .gradient-text{
      background:var(--gradient-hero);-webkit-background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
    }

    .hero__tagline{
      font-size:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.2rem);color:var(--clr-muted);
      margin-bottom:12px;animation:fadeSlideUp .8s .3s ease both;
    }
    .hero__tagline .tag{
      display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;
      border-radius:4px;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:600;
      font-family:var(--ff-mono);margin:2px 2px;
    }
    .tag--green{background:var(--clr-accent-bg);color:var(--clr-accent);border:1px solid rgba(0,229,160,.2)}
    .tag--cyan{background:var(--clr-cyan-bg);color:var(--clr-cyan);border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.2)}
    .tag--amber{background:var(--clr-amber-bg);color:var(--clr-amber);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,0,.2)}

    .hero__bio{
      color:var(--clr-muted);font-size:var(--fs-body);
      max-width:520px;margin-bottom:36px;
      animation:fadeSlideUp .8s .45s ease both;
    }

    .hero__actions{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;animation:fadeSlideUp .8s .6s ease both}

    /* Buttons */
    .btn{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
      padding:14px 30px;border-radius:50px;
      font-size:var(--fs-small);font-weight:600;
      cursor:pointer;border:none;
      transition:transform var(--transition),box-shadow var(--transition),background var(--transition);
    }
    .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}

    .btn--primary{
      background:var(--gradient);color:#050a0e;
      box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,229,160,.3);
    }
    .btn--primary:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,229,160,.45)}

    .btn--outline{
      background:transparent;color:var(--clr-text);
      border:1.5px solid var(--clr-border);
    }
    .btn--outline:hover{
      border-color:var(--clr-accent);color:var(--clr-accent);
      box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,229,160,.12);
    }

    /* ===== 3D Code Cube ===== */
    .cube-scene{
      width:280px;height:280px;
      perspective:800px;
      margin:0 auto;
      animation:fadeSlideUp 1s .4s ease both;
    }

    .cube{
      width:100%;height:100%;
      position:relative;
      transform-style:preserve-3d;
      animation:rotateCube 12s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .cube__face{
      position:absolute;width:280px;height:280px;
      background:rgba(10,16,24,.92);
      border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);
      padding:24px;
      font-family:var(--ff-mono);
      font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;
      color:var(--clr-muted);overflow:hidden;
      backface-visibility:hidden;
      box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,229,160,.05);
    }

    .cube__face::before{
      content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:32px;
      background:var(--clr-card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
    }

    .cube__face .dots{
      position:absolute;top:10px;left:14px;
      display:flex;gap:6px;z-index:1;
    }
    .cube__face .dots span{
      width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
    }
    .dot-r{background:#ff5f57}
    .dot-y{background:#ffbd2e}
    .dot-g{background:#28ca42}

    .cube__face .code{margin-top:20px;position:relative}

    .code .kw{color:var(--clr-cyan)}
    .code .fn{color:var(--clr-accent)}
    .code .str{color:var(--clr-amber)}
    .code .cm{color:#4a5568;font-style:italic}
    .code .num{color:#c084fc}
    .code .op{color:#f0f4f8}

    .cube__face--front {transform:rotateY(0deg) translateZ(140px)}
    .cube__face--right {transform:rotateY(90deg) translateZ(140px)}
    .cube__face--back  {transform:rotateY(180deg) translateZ(140px)}
    .cube__face--left  {transform:rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(140px)}
    .cube__face--top   {transform:rotateX(90deg) translateZ(140px)}
    .cube__face--bottom{transform:rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(140px)}

    /* Floating particles around cube */
    .cube-scene::before,
    .cube-scene::after{
      content:'< />';position:absolute;
      font-family:var(--ff-mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
      color:var(--clr-accent);opacity:.3;
      animation:float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .cube-scene::before{top:-10px;right:20px;content:'{ }';animation-delay:-2s}
    .cube-scene::after{bottom:10px;left:10px;content:'< />';animation-delay:-4s}

    /* Scroll indicator */
    .hero__scroll{
      position:absolute;bottom:32px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;
      color:var(--clr-muted);font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-family:var(--ff-mono);
      animation:fadeSlideUp 1s 1s ease both;
    }
    .hero__scroll .line{
      width:1px;height:40px;background:var(--clr-border);
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .hero__scroll .line::after{
      content:'';position:absolute;top:-100%;left:0;
      width:100%;height:50%;background:var(--clr-accent);
      animation:scrollLine 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    /* ===== About ===== */
    .about__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}

    .about__visual{position:relative}

    .about__terminal{
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    }

    .terminal__bar{
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
      padding:12px 16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--clr-border);
    }
    .terminal__bar span{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%}
    .terminal__bar .title{
      margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;
      font-family:var(--ff-mono);font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--clr-muted);
    }

    .terminal__body{
      padding:20px;font-family:var(--ff-mono);
      font-size:13px;line-height:2;color:var(--clr-muted);
    }

    .terminal__body .prompt{color:var(--clr-accent)}
    .terminal__body .cmd{color:var(--clr-white)}
    .terminal__body .output{color:var(--clr-cyan)}
    .terminal__body .str{color:var(--clr-amber)}

    .about__text p{color:var(--clr-muted);margin-bottom:20px}

    .about__stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:36px}

    .stat{
      text-align:center;padding:20px 12px;
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);
      transition:border-color var(--transition),transform var(--transition);
    }
    .stat:hover{border-color:var(--clr-accent);transform:translateY(-4px)}

    .stat__number{
      font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px;
      background:var(--gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
    }
    .stat__label{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--clr-muted)}

    /* ===== Education ===== */
    #education{background:var(--clr-surface)}

    .timeline{position:relative;max-width:700px}
    .timeline::before{
      content:'';position:absolute;left:20px;top:0;bottom:0;
      width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--clr-accent),var(--clr-cyan),transparent);
    }

    .timeline__item{position:relative;padding-left:60px;padding-bottom:40px}
    .timeline__item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}

    .timeline__dot{
      position:absolute;left:12px;top:4px;
      width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--clr-bg);border:3px solid var(--clr-accent);z-index:1;
      box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,229,160,.3);
    }

    .timeline__card{
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px;
      transition:border-color var(--transition),transform var(--transition),box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .timeline__card:hover{
      border-color:var(--clr-accent);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    }

    .timeline__year{
      display:inline-block;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:600;
      font-family:var(--ff-mono);color:var(--clr-accent);
      background:var(--clr-accent-bg);padding:4px 14px;
      border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:12px;
    }

    .timeline__card h3{font-size:var(--fs-h3);font-weight:700;color:var(--clr-white);margin-bottom:4px}
    .timeline__card p{color:var(--clr-muted);font-size:var(--fs-small)}

    /* ===== Skills ===== */
    .skills__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:24px}

    .skill-card{
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);padding:32px 28px;
      transition:border-color var(--transition),transform var(--transition),box-shadow var(--transition);
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .skill-card:hover{
      border-color:var(--clr-accent);transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    }
    .skill-card::before{
      content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;
      background:var(--gradient);opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--transition);
    }
    .skill-card:hover::before{opacity:1}

    /* Colored top borders per card */
    .skill-card--green:hover{border-color:var(--clr-accent)}
    .skill-card--green::before{background:var(--gradient)}
    .skill-card--cyan:hover{border-color:var(--clr-cyan)}
    .skill-card--cyan::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00c8ff,#7c5cff)}
    .skill-card--amber:hover{border-color:var(--clr-amber)}
    .skill-card--amber::before{background:var(--gradient-warm)}
    .skill-card--purple:hover{border-color:#a78bfa}
    .skill-card--purple::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#ec4899)}

    .skill-card__icon{
      width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:var(--radius);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      margin-bottom:20px;font-size:1.5rem;
    }
    .icon--green{background:var(--clr-accent-bg)}
    .icon--cyan{background:var(--clr-cyan-bg)}
    .icon--amber{background:var(--clr-amber-bg)}
    .icon--purple{background:rgba(167,139,250,.08)}

    .skill-card h3{font-size:var(--fs-h3);font-weight:700;color:var(--clr-white);margin-bottom:8px}
    .skill-card p{color:var(--clr-muted);font-size:var(--fs-small);line-height:1.6}

    .skill-bar{margin-top:18px}
    .skill-bar__header{
      display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
      font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--clr-muted);margin-bottom:6px;
      font-family:var(--ff-mono);
    }
    .skill-bar__track{width:100%;height:6px;background:var(--clr-border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
    .skill-bar__fill{
      height:100%;border-radius:6px;width:0;
      transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    .skill-bar__fill.animate{width:var(--fill)}
    .fill--green{background:var(--gradient)}
    .fill--cyan{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00c8ff,#7c5cff)}
    .fill--amber{background:var(--gradient-warm)}
    .fill--purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#ec4899)}

    /* ===== Hobbies ===== */
    #hobbies{background:var(--clr-surface)}

    .hobbies__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:24px}

    .hobby-card{
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);padding:36px 28px;text-align:center;
      transition:border-color var(--transition),transform var(--transition),box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .hobby-card:hover{border-color:var(--clr-accent);transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}

    .hobby-card__icon{
      width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 20px;border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--clr-accent-bg);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.7rem;
      transition:background var(--transition),transform var(--transition);
    }
    .hobby-card:hover .hobby-card__icon{
      background:rgba(0,229,160,.15);transform:scale(1.1);
    }

    .hobby-card h3{font-size:var(--fs-h3);font-weight:700;color:var(--clr-white);margin-bottom:8px}
    .hobby-card p{color:var(--clr-muted);font-size:var(--fs-small);line-height:1.6}

    /* ===== Contact ===== */
    .contact__wrapper{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px}

    .contact__info h3{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--clr-white);margin-bottom:16px}
    .contact__info p{color:var(--clr-muted);margin-bottom:32px}

    .contact__detail{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
    .contact__detail-icon{
      width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:var(--radius);
      background:var(--clr-accent-bg);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .contact__detail-text span{display:block;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--clr-muted)}
    .contact__detail-text a,.contact__detail-text strong{
      color:var(--clr-white);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--fs-body);
    }
    .contact__detail-text a:hover{color:var(--clr-accent)}

    .contact__form{
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:36px;
    }
    .form-group{margin-bottom:20px}
    .form-group label{
      display:block;font-size:var(--fs-small);font-weight:600;
      color:var(--clr-text);margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .form-group input,.form-group textarea{
      width:100%;padding:14px 18px;
      background:var(--clr-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--clr-border);
      border-radius:var(--radius);color:var(--clr-text);
      font-family:var(--ff);font-size:var(--fs-body);outline:none;
      transition:border-color var(--transition),box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .form-group input:focus,.form-group textarea:focus{
      border-color:var(--clr-accent);
      box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,229,160,.12);
    }
    .form-group textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:120px}

    /* ===== Footer ===== */
    .footer{
      background:var(--clr-surface);border-top:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      padding:48px 0 28px;
    }
    .footer__inner{
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
      flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;
    }
    .footer__brand{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--clr-white)}
    .footer__brand span{
      background:var(--gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
    }

    .footer__socials{display:flex;gap:12px}
    .footer__socials a{
      width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--clr-card);border:1px solid var(--clr-border);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--clr-muted);
      transition:color var(--transition),border-color var(--transition),transform var(--transition),background var(--transition);
    }
    .footer__socials a:hover{
